subject: general
question: The Union Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment in the year 2015 notified that every year ______ will be celebrated as the 'Constitution Day' to promote Constitutional values among citizens.
solution:
The correct answer is __**26 November**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 26 November is celebrated as Constitution Day or Samvidhan Diwas in India annually.
 
• The day is also known as National Law Day.
 
• It was on this day in 1949 that the Indian Constitution was adopted by the constituent assembly, and, thereafter, came into force on January 26, 1950, marking the beginning of India as a republic.
 
• Dr. B. R. Ambedkar is known as the father of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Government of India declared 26 November as Constitution Day on 19 November 2015 by a gazette notification.
 
• ​2015 was the 125th birth anniversary year of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar.
